description: Rotate the API key this session is authenticated with. Two-step and server-enforced: called WITHOUT confirm_phrase it only returns an impact report plus the exact phrase required, and changes nothing. Called with the exact phrase it generates a new key (returned once, never again), keeps the old key alive for a 24h grace window (immediate: true kills it instantly), resets usage counters, and forces MCP write access off. Always show the user the impact report and get their explicit go-ahead before confirming.

confirm_phrase.description: The exact confirmation phrase ("rotate-<domain>"). Omit to get the impact report first.

immediate.description: true = the old key dies instantly instead of getting the 24h grace window

name: rotate_api_key
